items.title: Occidental beats Q3 forecasts as production offsets lower crude prices
items.summary: Investing.com -- Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) delivered a decisive third-quarter earnings beat on Monday, lifted by operational outperformance in its core shale basins and substantial debt-reduction progress. The Houston-based producer posted adjusted earnings of $1.91 per share, topping analyst expectations of $1.34 by $0.57, while revenue reached $6.77 billion against a projected $6.61 billion.
